info.title: OnlineSchool API
info.description: Business commands with server-side sessions, MFA, CSRF and transactional idempotency. Money is a decimal string.

exceptionAmount.description: Exact NUMERIC(20,4) decimal string; JSON numbers and exponents are rejected. Positive for payments/lines; zero only for explicit director accrual decision.

amount.description: Exact NUMERIC(20,4) decimal string; JSON numbers and exponents are rejected. Positive for payments/lines; zero only for explicit director accrual decision.

kind.description: TRIAL is scheduled atomically through the lead trial endpoint.

subscriptionId.description: Managed subscription (study direction). Required if multiple active subscriptions exist.

startsAt.description: Must match the prepared financial package start.

estimatedReadyAt.description: Estimate only; poll every 2s for at most 60s, then retry later

url.description: Private HTTPS presigned GET capability. Maximum lifetime 15 minutes; shorter if the explicit permission expires first.

FinanceMoney.description: Exact NUMERIC(20,4) decimal string; JSON numbers and exponents are rejected. Positive for payments/lines; zero only for explicit director accrual decision.

conversion30dBp.description: Converted leads / leads created in the trailing 30-day cohort, in basis points

entitlement_balance_before.description: Subscription lessons remaining immediately before consumption; quantitative, not money

entitlement_balance_after.description: Subscription lessons remaining immediately after consumption; quantitative, not money

debit.description: Exact NUMERIC(20,4) decimal string; JSON numbers and exponents are rejected. Positive for payments/lines; zero only for explicit director accrual decision.

balanceAfter.description: Subscription lessons after deduction, immutable Decimal string

studentNoShow.description: Explicit student absence, only with NOT_CONDUCTED; student-facing NO_SHOW requires staff confirmation

priority.description: Omitted when the priority source is not configured; null if it is unavailable.

consumed.description: Only a subscription operation consumes an allocation; account activation does not.

pendingChangeId.description: Specific director exception request. Re-submit the same change with a new command key after approval.

studentId.description: CRM contact; does not establish ownership of funds.
